reply_to_message.description: Post a native threaded reply to one Discord message and return a receipt, or dry-run the same sequence without submitting. Handles scroll-into-view, hover toolbar, Reply control, reply-mode detection, typing, single Enter, persistence scan and permalink verification.

dryRun.description: Type and verify, then clear the composer; never submits

targetId.description: Existing owned tab to reuse. When set, the tool neither creates nor closes a tab and leaves the caller's page in place

list_guild_rail.description: Read the guild rail, separating servers from folder rows: id, name, unread flag, aria-level and position for each server, and each folder with its expansion state and parsed member list.

returns.description: { servers: [{ id, name, unread, level, pos, size }], folders: [{ id, members, membersTruncated, expanded, level, pos, size }], total }

list_channels.description: Open a guild and read its sidebar: channel id (from href), name and kind parsed from aria-label, with the lazy-load retry and stale-list detection Discord needs.

previous.description: Channel ids from the previous guild read; a list identical to this is treated as not yet rendered

returns.description: { guildId, channels: [{ cid, gid, name, kind, label }], attempts, stale }

list_forum_posts.description: Read a forum channel's post list with titles and reply counts from each row's aria-label.

returns.description: { forumChannelId, posts: [{ tid, title, messageCount }], attempts }

read_channel_end.description: Navigate to one channel (or post URL) and return the tail of the message list with id, time, author, own text and quoted preview resolved per row.

limit.description: Rows to return from the end, default 8

mask.description: Replace @mentions with [mention] for text leaving the workspace

returns.description: { channelUrl, messages: [{ id, time, author, text, quoted }], attempts }

read_channel_series.description: Read several channels one after another. Use this instead of concurrent calls: overlapping reads into one Discord session return stale channel lists and can strand composer text.

urls.description: Channel URLs, read in the given order

returns.description: One readChannelEnd result per url, in order
